entries.name: Information Security Policies
entries.description: A complete set of information security policies is approved by management.

entries.name: Roles And Responsibilities
entries.description: Information security roles and responsibilities are defined.

entries.name: Management Direction
entries.description: Management direction for information security is documented.

entries.name: Contact With Authorities
entries.description: Contacts with relevant authorities are maintained.

entries.name: Special Interest Groups
entries.description: Contact with special interest groups and security forums is maintained.

entries.name: Threat Intelligence
entries.description: Threat intelligence is collected and analyzed.

entries.name: Information Security In Projects
entries.description: Information security is integrated into project management.

entries.name: Asset Inventory
entries.description: An inventory of information assets is maintained.

entries.name: Acceptable Use Policy
entries.description: An acceptable use policy for assets exists.

entries.name: Return Of Assets
entries.description: Assets are returned when employment or engagement ends.
entries.declaration_text: I confirm that all organizational assets issued to personnel and third parties whose employment or engagement ended during this period have been returned or verifiably wiped, and that the return has been recorded.

entries.name: Data Classification Policy
entries.description: A data classification policy exists.

entries.name: Information Labeling Policy
entries.description: An information labeling policy exists.

entries.name: Information Transfer Policy
entries.description: An information transfer policy exists.

entries.name: Access Control Policy
entries.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information are established, based on business and information security requirements.

entries.name: Access Rights Review
entries.description: A periodic access rights review is performed.

entries.name: Supplier Security Policy
entries.description: A supplier security policy exists.

entries.name: Supplier Assurance Evidence
entries.description: Each supplier in the third-party register has current assurance evidence on file.

entries.name: Supplier Security Agreements
entries.description: Each supplier in the third-party register has an agreement addressing information security on file.

entries.name: Supplier Onboarding and Termination Process
entries.description: A documented process governs supplier onboarding and termination, including revoking access and returning or destroying information.

entries.name: ICT Supply Chain Security
entries.description: Information security is managed across the ICT supply chain.

entries.name: Supplier Service Monitoring
entries.description: Supplier service delivery is monitored.

entries.name: Cloud Services Security
entries.description: Information security requirements for the use of cloud services are defined.

entries.name: Incident Management Plan
entries.description: An incident management plan exists.

entries.name: Security Event Assessment
entries.description: Security events are assessed and classified before being declared incidents.

entries.name: Incident Response Tested
entries.description: Incident response is tested.

items.text: Incident response plan was tested via tabletop exercise or simulation
All incident response roles and responsibilities were verified
Communication channels and escalation paths were tested
Lessons learned were documented and the plan updated accordingly

entries.name: Lessons Learned From Incidents
entries.description: Lessons are learned from incidents.

entries.name: Evidence Collection Procedure
entries.description: Evidence relating to security events is identified, collected, and preserved.

entries.name: Information Security In BCP
entries.description: Information security is maintained during disruption.

entries.name: ICT Continuity Tested
entries.description: ICT continuity is tested.

items.text: ICT continuity arrangements were exercised against a representative scenario
Gaps identified during the test were documented and remediated

entries.name: Legal Requirements Inventory
entries.description: Legal, statutory, and contractual requirements are inventoried.

entries.name: Intellectual Property Rights
entries.description: Intellectual property rights are respected.
entries.declaration_text: I confirm that the organization complies with legislative, regulatory, and contractual requirements for intellectual property rights and software licensing, and that no unlicensed software is knowingly used on organizational systems during this period.

entries.name: Privacy And PII Protection
entries.description: Privacy and PII protection requirements are documented.

entries.name: Independent Security Review
entries.description: Information security is independently reviewed.

entries.name: Compliance With Policies
entries.description: Compliance with security policies is monitored and attested.
entries.declaration_text: I confirm that compliance with the organization's information security policies and standards has been reviewed during this period and that identified non-conformities have been recorded and addressed.

entries.name: Documented Operating Procedures
entries.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities are documented.

entries.name: Personnel Screening
entries.description: Personnel are screened prior to employment.

entries.name: Terms Of Employment
entries.description: Employment terms include security responsibilities.

entries.name: Security Awareness Training
entries.description: Personnel complete security awareness training.

entries.name: Disciplinary Process
entries.description: A disciplinary process for security violations exists.

entries.name: Responsibilities On Termination
entries.description: Security responsibilities persist after termination.

entries.name: NDA Confidentiality Agreement
entries.description: Confidentiality / non-disclosure agreements are in place.
entries.declaration_text: I confirm that all personnel and relevant third parties with access to organizational information have signed confidentiality / non-disclosure agreements that remain in force during this period.

entries.name: Remote Working Policy
entries.description: A remote working policy protects information accessed outside the organization's premises.

entries.name: Security Event Reporting
entries.description: Personnel have a defined channel for reporting information security events.

entries.name: Physical Security Perimeters
entries.description: Physical security perimeters are defined.

entries.name: Physical Entry Controls
entries.description: Physical entry controls are implemented.

entries.name: Securing Offices And Facilities
entries.description: Offices, rooms, and facilities holding information assets are physically secured.

entries.name: Physical Security Monitoring
entries.description: Physical security is monitored.

entries.name: Physical And Environmental Threats
entries.description: Facilities holding information assets are protected against physical and environmental threats.

entries.name: Working In Secure Areas
entries.description: Rules for working in secure areas are defined and followed.
entries.declaration_text: I confirm that secure areas within the organization's control are identified and that the rules for working in them are defined and followed during this period, and that where the organization operates no secure areas of its own, the hosting facilities are run by a third-party provider under its own certified controls.

entries.name: Clear Desk Clear Screen Policy
entries.description: A clear-desk / clear-screen policy exists.

entries.name: Equipment Siting Protection
entries.description: Equipment holding information assets is sited and protected against physical risk.

entries.name: Assets Off Premises
entries.description: Assets used away from the organization's premises are protected.

entries.name: Storage Media Policy
entries.description: A storage media handling policy exists.

entries.name: Supporting Utilities
entries.description: Information processing facilities are protected from failure of supporting utilities.

entries.name: Cabling Security
entries.description: Cabling carrying power and data is protected from interception and damage.

entries.name: Equipment Maintenance
entries.description: Equipment is maintained so that information stays available and intact.

entries.name: Secure Disposal Policy
entries.description: A secure disposal / reuse policy for equipment exists.

entries.name: Endpoint Device Policy
entries.description: An endpoint / user device security policy exists.

entries.name: Capacity Management Process
entries.description: A capacity management process exists.

entries.name: Technical Vulnerability Management Process
entries.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities is obtained, exposure is evaluated, and appropriate measures are taken.

entries.name: Information Deletion Policy
entries.description: An information deletion policy exists.

entries.name: Data Masking Policy
entries.description: Data masking is applied where required to limit exposure of sensitive data.

entries.name: Log Review Process
entries.description: Logs recording activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events are reviewed and analyzed.

entries.name: Clock Synchronization
entries.description: System clocks are synchronized to an approved time source.

entries.name: Privileged Utility Programs
entries.description: Use of privileged utility programs is restricted and controlled.

entries.name: Software Installation Policy
entries.description: A software installation policy for operational systems exists.

entries.name: Web Filtering Policy
entries.description: A web filtering policy exists.

entries.name: Cryptography and Key Management Policy
entries.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, are defined and implemented.

entries.name: Application Security Requirements
entries.description: Application security requirements are defined.

entries.name: Secure Architecture Principles
entries.description: Secure system architecture principles are documented.

entries.name: Outsourced Development Policy
entries.description: Outsourced development is governed and monitored.

entries.name: Environment Separation
entries.description: Development, test, and production environments are separated.

items.text: Development, test, and production run as separate, isolated environments
Access to production is granted separately from development and test access
Changes reach production only through a controlled promotion process
Production data is not copied into development or test environments without approval and masking

entries.name: Test Information Policy
entries.description: Test information is protected.

entries.name: Audit Testing Protection Policy
entries.description: Audit testing of operational systems is controlled.

entries.name: Change Management Policy
entries.description: A change management policy exists.

entries.name: ISMS Context
entries.description: The internal and external issues relevant to the ISMS, and the requirements of interested parties, are determined and documented.

entries.name: ISMS Scope
entries.description: The scope of the ISMS is determined and available as documented information.

entries.name: ISMS Policy
entries.description: Top management has established an information security policy appropriate to the purpose of the organization.

entries.name: ISMS Roles
entries.description: Responsibilities and authorities for the ISMS are assigned and communicated by top management.

entries.name: Risk Assessment Process
entries.description: A documented information security risk assessment process defines the risk criteria and how risks are identified, analyzed and evaluated.

entries.name: Risk Treatment Process
entries.description: A documented information security risk treatment process selects treatment options and determines the necessary controls.

entries.name: ISMS Objectives
entries.description: Information security objectives are established at relevant functions and levels, and are documented.

entries.name: Competence Records
entries.description: The competence of persons doing work affecting information security performance is determined and evidenced.

entries.name: Documented Information
entries.description: Documented information required by the ISMS is identified, controlled, and available where needed.

entries.name: Operational Planning
entries.description: The processes needed to meet information security requirements are planned, implemented and controlled, and outsourced processes are controlled.

entries.name: Risk Assessment Results
entries.description: Information security risk assessments are performed at planned intervals and the results are retained.

entries.name: Risk Treatment Results
entries.description: The information security risk treatment plan is implemented and the results are retained.

entries.name: ISMS Monitoring
entries.description: The information security performance and the effectiveness of the ISMS are monitored, measured, analyzed and evaluated.

entries.name: Internal Audit
entries.description: Internal audits of the ISMS are conducted at planned intervals under a defined audit program.

entries.name: Management Review
entries.description: Top management reviews the ISMS at planned intervals and the results are retained.

entries.name: Corrective Action
entries.description: Nonconformities are reacted to, their causes evaluated, and corrective action taken and recorded.
